name: beaconfall
archive_reason: Test bed for validating AIKit project gates, Reforge and Keystone integration; game work pushed to its repo, project retired.
archive_description: [ARCHIVED] Beaconfall is a 3D downhill time trial built with Keystone. Drive 400 metres through a pine-lined mountain course, steer around boulders and reach the finish before the clock runs out. No single stationary line avoids every obstacle.
